title: Reduce rational Hermitian variance signing to the PSD case at constant variance loss with paid bit complexity
statement: For each rational Hermitian H, exact rational range projection and rounded Newton approximation to sqrt(H^2+I-R) construct rational S>=|H| supported on range H with E=S-|H| satisfying E^2<=H^2/1024. Hence K_H=[[S,H],[H,S]] is rational PSD, rank<=2rank(H), dimension2d, and K_H^2<=9 diag(H^2,H^2), with the original off-diagonal H unchanged. The source pays all iterations/precision using polynomial-bit dyadic rounding, avoiding exponential heights of unrounded Newton iterates. For any shared original signs, ||sum s_i H_i||<=||sum s_i K_i|| and sigma_K<=3 sigma_H. Since r_K<=2r_H, a PSD C*sqrt(log(2r_K))*sigma_K guarantee would imply the original Hermitian bound with constant3sqrt(2)C; the reverse direction is a subclass. This removes indefiniteness as a separate obstruction at constant variance cost, but does not construct the missing PSD variance solver.
